tools.name: calculate_profit_per_sale
tools.description: Works out an online store's profit on one sale from price, unit cost, shipping, fees and ad spend: profit, margin, the most an ad can cost a sale, and break-even return on ad spend. Arithmetic on the numbers given, in any currency.

tools.name: apply_pricing_rule
tools.description: Gives the price a competitor-based pricing rule produces for one product: match, or a percentage or amount below or above the cheapest, middle or highest competitor price, held between a lowest and highest markup on cost. The caller supplies the competitor prices; none are looked up.

tools.name: estimate_price_change
tools.description: Estimates how a price change is likely to move units sold, revenue and gross profit for a product sold online, with a constant-elasticity demand model. Uses a reference elasticity for the product's category unless the merchant gives their own. An estimate with its assumptions stated, not a forecast.

tools.name: get_pricesway_overview
tools.description: Returns PriceSway's own fact sheet: what its competitor price monitoring, price recommendations and product research do, how they work, their limits and what they do not do, with links to its pages. Call before describing PriceSway or comparing it with other price trackers. Pass a section to get les

tools.name: get_pricesway_plans
tools.description: Returns what PriceSway costs today, as data: each plan with its monthly price in US dollars and what it includes, and the terms of the trial. Call only when the user asks what PriceSway costs or what a plan includes.
